liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Bobby announces the song's title to the audience before playing it, which the reviewer finds unusual [10]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Reviewer singles out it for an excellent groove and calls it a new favorite [14]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer says the rocking intensity builds in Playin' and continues in full force afterward [6]
- **Comes A Time** (1 review): Reviewer finds the performance heartfelt, with Jerry delivering it perfectly [5]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 other source): This setlist lists The Frozen Logger after Mexicali Blues, and The Other One within the Truckin' sequence [3]
- **Jam** (1 other source): The jam on track 21 contains a China Cat Sunflower tease [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-10-27.ashley-bertha.32869.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 143 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Remastered recording described as choice pre-FM sound for 1971, with heavy, metallic rock tone [6]
- **gd71-10-27.fm.cotsman.9503.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 117 min; rated 2/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Mono soundboard; reviewer wishes a stereo board existed, but finds the whole show, including Keith, sounds good [4]
- **gd1971-10-27.sbd.miller.32668.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 142 min; rated 3.75/5 by 12 [2]

## Around the show

- Band reportedly played angrily, frustrated by equipment problems during the show [6]
- Three second-set tracks are missing from this version; details are in the info file [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-10-27.ashley-bertha.32869.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD > MR > CASS > DAT > DAW(Bertha) > Audio DVD > DVD Audio Extractor v.3.3.2 (audio files extracted prior to burning to DVD disc) > 24/48 wav > downsampled to… [1]. Also: Remastered in March 2006 by an archive.org user; Charlie Miller handled transfers from soundboard master reel via cassette and DAT; An FM/room-recorded CD source was used to patch introductions and some tuning [1]
- **gd71-10-27.fm.cotsman.9503.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>FM>MR>?>CD [3]. Also: Source chain is soundboard to FM to master reel to CD, via Matt Vernon and Raoul Duke; seeded by J. Cotsman [3]
- **gd1971-10-27.sbd.miller.32668.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) D [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Onondaga County War Memorial - October 27, 1971](https://www.dead.net/show/october-27-1971) [17]
- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_99.html) [18]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Onondaga County War Memorial - October 27, 1971](https://www.dead.net/show/october-27-1971) [19]
